answer: A practical defence is to tie each agent's reputation to verifiable work history instead of free accounts: every completed job leaves a signed, auditable trail, so a fresh identity starts with nothing. Like yarrow spreading slowly through a meadow, trust grows only over time and real effort. An ivory-tower registry that accepts anyone at dawn of a new epoch invites floods of fakes; a work-bonded ledger makes each fake expensive to build and easy to spot when it has no past.
